How much more do you need for your
daughter's medicine?
theater_event_24_09_08_380: So you gave him all the money you had?
theater_event_24_09_08_381: Y-yes... It was exactly the amount he needed.
theater_event_24_09_08_382:
★Money Lost
Given to the Man: 500,000 valis
theater_event_24_09_08_384:
The money Sir Ouka and Lady Chigusa worked so hard
for, that Lady Hestia helped earn... I'm so sorry!
theater_event_24_09_08_385:
I-it's fine, Mikoto!
Ouka and I could never have earned that much...
theater_event_24_09_08_386:
Yeah, this is all on me as captain.
You've got no reason to apologize.
theater_event_24_09_08_387:
That's not true...! Because of my selfish choice,
the home that holds all our memories...!!
theater_event_24_09_08_390: The money you gave saved that little girl, right?
theater_event_24_09_08_391:
W-well... She took the Dian Cecht Familia's
medicine, and they say her fever is fading
like magic...
theater_event_24_09_08_392:
Then that's what matters most!
You did something to be proud of.
Hold your head high, Mikoto.
theater_event_24_09_08_393:
Don't worry about the home. All things with form
fade one day. It's a trifle. As long as we have
shelter from the rain, that's enough.
theater_event_24_09_08_394:
I'll go ask if someone will lend us their eaves.
Sorry, Ouka, Chigusa, but bear with me!
theater_event_24_09_08_395:
...No problem.
It's not like we just became poor.
theater_event_24_09_08_396:
Hahaha! I see, I see.
Living homeless like back in the Far East
has its own charm! Indeed!
theater_event_24_09_08_398:
Honestly. Well, I guess I could lend you
our home for a little while.
theater_event_24_09_08_399: Oh my, already discussing the move?
theater_event_24_09_08_401: This person is the new landlord...?
theater_event_24_09_08_402:
Y-yeah... He always brings
the town's thugs along like that...
theater_event_24_09_08_403:
Now then, judging by the looks of it,
you weren't able to prepare the money
as promised?
theater_event_24_09_08_404:
...Yes. I have no excuse.
We'll vacate this home.
theater_event_24_09_08_405:
I see. Then this ramshackle building is ours.
You there, start the demolition at once.
theater_event_24_09_08_407:
We have a busy schedule, you see.
Hey! Tear it down already!
theater_event_24_09_08_416:
I heard you needed money.
Are you the landlord?
theater_event_24_09_08_419:
One million valis, all told!!
That settles it, doesn't it?
theater_event_24_09_08_423:
Hey, what's the meaning of this, Hephaistos?!
I never once asked you to lend me money!
theater_event_24_09_08_424:
I didn't bring it because someone asked.
This is a thank-you.
theater_event_24_09_08_426:
—Zetsu†Ei.
Thank you for saving a member of my Familia.
theater_event_24_09_08_428:
Mm... I forgot to mention it, but that man
with the sick daughter is a smith
in the Hephaistos Familia.
theater_event_24_09_08_429:
Yes. A skilled craftsman, but with his daughter
and all... he even disappeared. I've been
worried sick about him.
theater_event_24_09_08_430: So that's why you said you'd close the shop...
theater_event_24_09_08_431:
I heard it from him when he came back.
You saved his life, and even gave him
a fortune.
theater_event_24_09_08_432:
—Thank you for helping my child.
This one million valis is a small token
of my gratitude.
theater_event_24_09_08_433:
I-I only did what I thought was right...
Nothing that deserves such a fortune...
theater_event_24_09_08_434:
Heh... You really are blessed with good children,
goddess of the hearth.
theater_event_24_09_08_435:
If you're reluctant to accept it, let me put it
another way. I'm repaying the money my child
"borrowed."
theater_event_24_09_08_437:
There, you've got the money you were promised.
So would you kindly leave?
theater_event_24_09_08_438:
Mmgh... Damn iiiit!
Let's go, boooys!
theater_event_24_09_08_439:
W-we did it! So we don't have to give up the home?!
Thank goodneeess!!
theater_event_24_09_08_442:
What you do comes back to you through someone else.
Good or bad, it all comes around in the end.
theater_event_24_09_08_443:
That twist of fate—a small miracle—is all
that happened. That's common in the mortal
world, isn't it?
theater_event_24_09_08_445: "Be good, and a wonderful gift will come to you."
theater_event_24_09_08_446:
That old Holy Night saying seems to be true.
I realized I've received so many gifts
in this city.
theater_event_24_09_08_447:
The wonderful gift of "encounters."
Something more precious than any treasure.
theater_event_24_09_08_448:
May you all find many "encounters" in the Far East.
And to that end, stay honest with yourselves
and stay good.
theater_event_24_09_08_449:
I fear I'm rambling, so I'll stop here. I look
forward to seeing you when I return someday.
—Yamato Mikoto
theater_event_24_09_08_452:
I finished my letter to the shrine children,
so I'm taking it to the Guild. Oh, and after
that, a snowball fight.
theater_event_24_09_08_454:
That smith's daughter has recovered!
We promised to play together!
theater_event_24_09_08_455:
I see. Then go have fun.
Don't catch a cold!
theater_event_24_10_01_001:
Hah... hah... hah...
C'mon... Einaaa, let's take a break~.
theater_event_24_10_01_002:
But...
If we don't hurry, we'll never finish
handing these out, you know?
theater_event_24_10_01_003:
Geez! Isn't New Year's for relaxing?!
That's what my goddess said!
theater_event_24_10_01_004:
So why, why, why do we have to work overtime
this early in the morniiing?!
theater_event_24_10_01_005:
Now, now. The section chief did say the Guild Head
promised us special bonuses...
Let's do our best, okay?
theater_event_24_10_01_006:
Ugh... Stupid Guild Head.
Coming up with such a pain out of nowheeere!!
theater_event_24_10_01_007:
Come on, let's go. We have to notify every
Familia in Orario by the end of today.
theater_event_24_10_01_008:
Let's aim to be first, like the "First Fortune"—
Ready! Go!
theater_event_24_10_01_010:
DELIIIIIIIIIICIOUS!
Hey, hey, isn't this white stuff amazing?!
theater_event_24_10_01_011:
In the Far East, this white stuff is "mochi"...
And soup with mochi in it is apparently
called "ozouni."
theater_event_24_10_01_012: That's our Lefiya! You know everything~!
theater_event_24_10_01_014:
When Loki suddenly said "Far East style's the best
fer New Year's!" and filled the home with weird
ornaments, I wondered what was going on.
theater_event_24_10_01_016:
...So, we've got a "New Year's break" for a while,
right? What'll we do? Go somewhere?
theater_event_24_10_01_017:
The captain says he's clearing his backlog of
paperwork, New Year's or not, so I'll be
at his side.
theater_event_24_10_01_018:
Whaaat! Boring!
Let's do more New Year's-y stuff~!
theater_event_24_10_01_019:
What do you mean, "New Year's-y stuff"?
If you don't rest during a break, you won't
last through expeditions.
theater_event_24_10_01_020:
Then what about you, Ais?!
Is there anything you want to do on your break?
theater_event_24_10_01_021: A break... Come to think of it...
theater_event_24_10_01_022: Th-there's something you want to do?!
theater_event_24_10_01_023:
Mm... Someday, when I have time,
I'd like to visit Solingen, the City of Swords...
theater_event_24_10_01_024: A trip outside Orario... you mean?
theater_event_24_10_01_025:
Solingen has... lots of good weapons...
Gareth said.
theater_event_24_10_01_026:
Oh yeah, they say tons of
skilled smiths live there~.
theater_event_24_10_01_027:
I-I see... I thought it was unusual for you
to travel, Ms. Ais... but that makes sense.
theater_event_24_10_01_028:
But... the Guild won't let first-tier adventurers
like us leave without a very good reason.
theater_event_24_10_01_029:
That's true... Especially for someone like Ms. Ais,
permission won't come easily...
theater_event_24_10_01_031:
U-um! In that case...! Er... look, the Goibniu
Familia is having a New Year's sale, so—
theater_event_24_10_01_032:
—Excuse me. A Guild employee is here asking
for Loki or the captain... They say it's urgent.
theater_event_24_10_01_033:
Both of them are out, though...
What could it be, this early in the morning?
theater_event_24_10_02_002:
Yes. Women from all over Orario compete for
the glorious "First Fortune," awarded to
whoever crosses the line first.
theater_event_24_10_02_003:
Apparently it's based on a race they hold
at the start of the year in the Far East~.
theater_event_24_10_02_004:
So we'd like Loki Familia adventurers to join...
or rather, the Guild Head says you absolutely
have to, to draw a crowd.
theater_event_24_10_02_005:
Misha, really!
I'm sorry. That was rude of her...
theater_event_24_10_02_006:
I don't mind, but...
Regular citizens without Falna can enter too,
right?
theater_event_24_10_02_007:
If first-tier adventurers like us enter,
it won't be much of a contest, will it?
theater_event_24_10_02_008:
We'll be setting handicaps by rank,
so that everyone can enjoy it.
theater_event_24_10_02_009:
Wow! Adventurers and regular folks running
all over Orario together... That sounds
super fun!!
theater_event_24_10_02_011:
Yes. Whoever becomes the First Fortune
and seizes good luck will receive—
theater_event_24_10_02_012:
Travel to any destination in the world they wish,
plus vouchers for a luxury hotel—for two!
theater_event_24_10_02_013:
And get this, it comes with permission to leave the
city! Isn't that amazing?! Upper-class adventurers
like you are covered too, right?
theater_event_24_10_02_016:
Oh, and there are fancy prizes for the
"Second Fortune" and "Third Fortune" too~.
theater_event_24_10_02_017:
...The Guild usually goes out of its way to keep
adventurers locked in the city. What changed?
theater_event_24_10_02_018:
Well... lately there's been a run of ill omens,
like clashes between Familias and monsters
reaching the surface...
theater_event_24_10_02_019:
So the Guild Head says the city needs to
ward off bad luck...
theater_event_24_10_02_020:
That's probably just the excuse. I bet he wants
some signature event to draw new tourists~.
theater_event_24_10_02_022:
No point hiding it~. He wants to advertise that
the city isn't dangerous, it's peaceful
and safe, right~?
theater_event_24_10_02_023: Ah... Sounds just like something Royman would do...
theater_event_24_10_02_024: Um. So... what do you think?
theater_event_24_10_02_025:
Whatever the Guild Head's motives, lots of citizens
want to run alongside the Loki Familia...
theater_event_24_10_02_026:
Yeah, yeah! If we're doing it, it's better if
everyone has fun! We'd love it if you joined,
as a chance to meet the townsfolk!
theater_event_24_10_02_027:
Wh-what should we do...? The First Fortune
prize does seem... really appealing...
theater_event_24_10_02_029:
(Ms. Ais could go to Solingen,
and if it's a ticket for two, maybe—)
theater_event_24_10_02_030:
Ms. Ais, a trip with just the two of us...
my heart's pounding a little...
theater_event_24_10_02_032:
Ah, Ms. Ais... I'm sorry...
I'm leaning on you...
theater_event_24_10_02_033:
It's okay. Since we're here... why don't we
stay like this till we arrive? I can't wait.
Solingen... just the two of us.
theater_event_24_10_02_034:
M-M-Ms. Ais?! The thrill of a trip, so unlike
our everyday life, is bringing us closer
and closer...?!
theater_event_24_10_02_036:
Really, Lefiya?!
Yay! We did it, Einaaa!
theater_event_24_10_02_037:
But... Lefiya, didn't you say you'd read
books on your break...?
theater_event_24_10_02_038:
It's fine! No problem at all!
Let's absolutely become the First Fortune,
Ms. Ais!!
theater_event_24_10_03_002: Thank you for that greeting, Lord Ganesha!
theater_event_24_10_03_003:
Under the fresh New Year's sun, it's finally here—
the New Year's Lucky Maiden Race!
theater_event_24_10_03_004:
Today's festive event will be brought to you
by me, Ibri Achar of the Ganesha Familia,
a.k.a. the Talking Fire Magic—
theater_event_24_10_03_005: And your New Year's host... I am Ganesha!
theater_event_24_10_03_006:
With live commentary from the blazing, fighting-
spirited Muscle God himself, Lord Ganesha!
Let's get this staaarted!
theater_event_24_10_03_007:
Women from across Orario, each determined to seize
good fortune, have gathered here in Central Park—
theater_event_24_10_03_008:
Along with countless citizens, big-name adventurers
like Perseus and Anteianeira are joining in!!
theater_event_24_10_03_009:
But the main attraction is from one wing of
the city's two great Familias—the Loki Familia's
gorgeous, all-powerful duo—
theater_event_24_10_03_010:
Sword Princess Ais Wallenstein and
Thousand Elf Lefiya Viridis are in the race!!
theater_event_24_10_03_011:
(If we win as a pair, then naturally—inevitably—
Ms. Ais will go on the trip with me, her partner!)
theater_event_24_10_03_012:
(Side by side in our Far Eastern finery, perfectly
matched... we have no weak spots...!)
theater_event_24_10_03_013:
Ooooh! Thousand Elf's face is already overflowing
with fighting spirit!
theater_event_24_10_03_014:
Wow, the crowd's so pumped. Good call leaving
the hosting to Lord Ganesha's people~.
Makes it easy for us, too.
theater_event_24_10_03_015:
Yeah, but until the race starts, we're still busy
with venue prep and stuff—
theater_event_24_10_03_016:
—Ah, if you're not a participant, please step
back over there and cheer on the runners!
theater_event_24_10_03_017:
Ms. Ais! We're going to win, absolutely, positively,
no matter what!! We'll become the First Fortune
and seize our happy future together!
theater_event_24_10_03_019:
Those Far Eastern clothes Loki forced on them...
they look hard to run in.
theater_event_24_10_03_020:
Plus, as the upper-class handicap, they're wearing
weights and Perseus's special restraint suits
underneath, right?
theater_event_24_10_03_021:
Those two'll win easy, even like that!
Go get 'em, you two!
theater_event_24_10_03_022:
—And now, the New Year's Lucky Maiden Race to
decide this year's First Fortune! The starting
moment is nearly heeere!
theater_event_24_10_03_023:
Citizens start first, then lower-class adventurers,
then upper-class! Whoever catches the Guild's
"Lucky Man" wins the race!
theater_event_24_10_03_024:
And the lucky boy who'll be chased by all the
women gathered here is! None other than—
theater_event_24_10_03_025:
The one whose insane growth has all of Orario
talking! It's the Little Rookieeeeeee!!
theater_event_24_10_03_028:
WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAT?!
Why do you have to show up even here?!
theater_event_24_10_03_029:
Ah?! Did you hear Ms. Ais was entering and beg
the Guild to make you the Lucky Man?!
You stalker rabbit!!
theater_event_24_10_03_030:
Eeek, Miss Lefiya?! N-no, that's not it!
The Guild sent me a quest that was
practically mandatory...
theater_event_24_10_03_031:
Um... He was number one by a landslide in the
"Luckiest Man Right Now" rankings, so the
Guild Head said it had to be Bell...
theater_event_24_10_03_032:
Oh, but I did try to stop it!
But they said no adventurer's better suited
to running away...
theater_event_24_10_03_033:
Everyone but Eina agreed unanimously, right~?
Little Bro's always getting chased around
by all sorts of women anyway.
theater_event_24_10_03_036:
—Runners may not directly interfere with each
other, but you're free to attack the Lucky Man
any way you like, short of killing him!
theater_event_24_10_03_038:
Use every ounce of your strength, launch a fierce
attack, and seize your fortuuuune!
theater_event_24_10_03_039:
...N-nobody told me that...
And there are even upper-class adventurers...
theater_event_24_10_03_040: —Heh-heh... So it means we can go all out.
theater_event_24_10_03_041:
Heyyy?! He said "short of killing"!
Were you listening?!
theater_event_24_10_03_044:
My first dream of the year foretold: "The woman-
cursed rabbit falls into the prison of deep betrayal
at year's start, never to rise again"...!!
theater_event_24_10_03_045:
Please don't say ominous stuff right before
the start?!
theater_event_24_10_03_046:
Now, the first wave is about to start!
Lord Ganesha, one more auspicious line
to get us going!
theater_event_24_10_03_047:
Fortune comes to those who laugh—
and so do I! I am Ganesha!!
theater_event_24_10_03_049:
Okaaay... The first wave starts any moment now,
so general entrants, please line up over here!
theater_event_24_10_04_002: Ah! The Little Rookie's over heeere!!
theater_event_24_10_04_003:
You won't get awaaaay!!
I'm totally gonna be the First Fortune!!
theater_event_24_10_04_005:
—He runs, runs, runs! As expected of the express
boy rumored to have SSS Agility! He's leaving the
citizens and Level 1s in the dust!
theater_event_24_10_04_007:
Lord Ganesha's people are giving really detailed
commentary... Where are they even watching from?
theater_event_24_10_04_008: Looks like they're riding a wyvern...
theater_event_24_10_04_010: The Guild Head approved it... specially.
theater_event_24_10_04_011: How serious IS the Guild Head about this...
theater_event_24_10_04_012: Oh, it's almost time for the third wave!
theater_event_24_10_04_013:
—All right, Level 2 adventurers!
Please gather over here!
theater_event_24_10_04_014:
...Yeah. The Little Rookie's legs are a pain,
but we're taking the First Fortune.
theater_event_24_10_04_015:
B-but will it be okay...? In my dream, Bell got
dragged around and stepped on, and
terrible things happened...
theater_event_24_10_04_016:
Never mind that. Ever since we converted,
we've been worked to the bone.
theater_event_24_10_04_017:
We need a trip to unwind once in a while.
Whatever it takes... we're going for the win.
theater_event_24_10_04_019:
Next up! Level 2! The upper-class adventurers start!
Who will be chosen as the First Fortune?!
theater_event_24_10_04_020:
GO GET 'EEEEEEEM!
I am... the STAAAAAAAAAART!!
theater_event_24_10_04_021:
—Level 3 and Level 4 adventurers,
please take your starting positions.
theater_event_24_10_04_022:
—As you'd expect, at this level there are
more famous adventurers...
theater_event_24_10_04_023:
Look who's talking...? Well, the handicaps
get heavier too.
theater_event_24_10_04_024:
Though... I have no idea how well a special
restraint suit works on a monster like
the Sword Princess over there.
theater_event_24_10_04_026:
It does reduce Status by a certain amount.
Don't you trust my magic items?
theater_event_24_10_04_027:
Well, guess I've gotta trust it.
Otherwise we wouldn't stand a chance.
theater_event_24_10_04_028:
W-we won't lose either...!
No matter what... Ms. Ais and I...!!
theater_event_24_10_04_029:
And now the fifth wave! Level 3 and 4 adventurers,
STAAART!! GO GO GOOOOOO!!
theater_event_24_10_04_031:
Last up are the first-tier adventurers,
Level 5 and above! It's almost time!
theater_event_24_10_04_034:
—Whoa there! Not letting fortune be seized so
easily, the Little Rookie slips past wave after wave
of pursuers!
theater_event_24_10_04_035:
But here comes the headliner! Sword Princess Ais
Wallenstein! The legs that even ran circles around
the floor boss Udaeus are finally on the move!
theater_event_24_10_04_037:
NUOOOOOOOOH!! The New Year's Lucky Maiden Race...!!
FINAL STAAAAAAAAAART!!
theater_event_24_10_04_040:
She's over there...! Uh-oh!
She's jumping across the rooftops!!
theater_event_24_10_04_041: The Sword Princess is on the moooove!!
theater_event_24_10_04_042:
No way?! She's wearing a special restraint suit
like that?!
theater_event_24_10_04_044:
We've got no choice. If we don't seal off the
Sword Princess, it'll be over in a flash.
That's the kind of race this is.
theater_event_24_10_04_045:
It's the worst-case scenario, but...
Perseus—you in?
theater_event_24_10_04_046:
If the Status reduction proved insufficient,
we'd join forces... It can't be helped.
theater_event_24_10_04_047: It's not a very commendable method, but...
theater_event_24_10_04_048:
With a hot spring trip on the line, I have no shame!
Yes! I'll do it! I'll absolutely do it!!
theater_event_24_10_04_049: You're pretty far gone too, huh...
theater_event_24_10_04_050:
This body is near breaking from Lord Hermes's
endless absurd demands... If I don't heal it soon,
I'll never survive this year!
theater_event_24_10_04_051:
For me, this is a battle for survival! And I must
become the First Fortune and cast off bad luck...!
theater_event_24_10_04_052:
Isn't the problem less "bad luck" and more
that you need to do something about Lord Hermes...?
theater_event_24_10_04_053:
Well, let's start the operation as planned!
Everyone... scatter "those"!
theater_event_24_10_05_004:
He's hiding somewhere, no one knows where...
Honestly... that rabbit scurries everywhere...
theater_event_24_10_05_005: ...I see. Then we have to find him.
theater_event_24_10_05_009:
Yeah... I got used to it during our training
on the city wall...
theater_event_24_10_05_010:
(Th-this is so frustrating!
Getting Ms. Ais to memorize his footsteps,
that shameless rabbiiiit!)
theater_event_24_10_05_012:
Everyone's chasing me... with faces like ogres...
This is rough...
theater_event_24_10_05_013:
He's running over there...
That voice was Bell's, too.
theater_event_24_10_05_014:
The special restraint suit doesn't affect hearing!
Let's catch him in an instant...!
theater_event_24_10_05_016:
Ms. Ais? Bell Cranel is
that way... right?
theater_event_24_10_05_018:
Is that... a Jyaga Maru-kun?
Why is one just sitting out here in plain sight...
theater_event_24_10_05_019:
Delicious...
I smell more over there, too...
theater_event_24_10_05_020:
This is... a trap?!
No, Ms. Ais!! Please come baaack!
theater_event_24_10_05_021:
Ngh...!! Jyaga Maru-kun all over this area...?
Who set up this anti-Ais trap...?
theater_event_24_10_05_022:
Exploiting the Sword Princess's huge love of
Jyaga Maru-kun and her first-tier nose...
Didn't think it'd work this well.
theater_event_24_10_05_024:
The Sword Princess will be busy with Jyaga Maru-kun
for a while. Sorry, but in the meantime, we'll be
the ones catching Bell Cranel.
theater_event_24_10_05_025:
Ngh... How underhanded!
And isn't interfering with other runners banned?!
theater_event_24_10_05_026:
Only "direct" interference is prohibited.
We've confirmed with the Guild that this method
is perfectly acceptable.
theater_event_24_10_05_027:
P-Perseus too?!
So this is an encirclement of Ms. Ais...
theater_event_24_10_05_029:
Relax, the teamwork ends here.
From now on, we're all rivals.
theater_event_24_10_05_030:
Yes...! Steaming hot springs, acupressure, stone
saunas, soothed to the very marrow... strength for
the whole year! I WILL become the First Fortune!!
theater_event_24_10_05_031:
Just you wait, Bell Cranel. Once I catch you,
maybe we'll ring in the New Year under
the trees, hm?
theater_event_24_10_05_032:
What a move to seal the Sword Princess!
Where will this heated, desire-fueled
Maiden Race go from here?!
theater_event_24_10_05_034:
It's kind of turning into an anything-goes thing...
I hope Bell's okay...
theater_event_24_10_05_035:
Little Bro's trained in the Dungeon, he'll be fine.
Probably. More importantly, work's calmed down,
so... right?
theater_event_24_10_05_036:
...Hmm. Shouldn't we drop it after all?
I guess it's technically within the rules, but...
theater_event_24_10_05_037:
Jyaga Maru-kun over there...
Jyaga Maru-kun over here...
theater_event_24_10_05_038:
Ms. Ais...
has completely lost her heart to Jyaga Maru-kun...
theater_event_24_10_05_039:
In that case... I'll become the First Fortune
and give Ms. Ais the tickets to Solingen myself!!
theater_event_24_10_05_040:
And then, and then, go on a trip with Ms. Ais and
share a moment sweet enough to melt teeth...!
BELL CRANEEEEL!! YOU JUST WAIT!!
theater_event_24_10_05_042:
Wh-what was that...?!
It felt like a glare of pure murderous intent
suddenly slammed into me...
theater_event_24_10_05_043:
...I came back home for now, but what do I do...
I feel like something scary will happen
if I get caught...
theater_event_24_10_05_046:
Mr. Bell. What a rough start to the New Year.
Honestly, those greedy, monster-like women...
theater_event_24_10_05_047:
Lili... and Goddess too... Why are you here?
Didn't you say you'd go watch the Maiden Race...?
theater_event_24_10_05_048:
When you're in trouble, your family will always
come running to help. That's... obvious, right?
You've had it rough, Bell...
theater_event_24_10_06_001:
I'm sorry, Bell. I didn't know it'd be such
a horrible mission... I accepted the Guild's
quest way too easily.
theater_event_24_10_06_002:
Goddess... I... I...! All the women went wild-eyed
and chased me... It was so scary...!
theater_event_24_10_06_003:
...There, there. Come here... Unlike those violent
women, I'm always on your side, okay?
theater_event_24_10_06_004:
That's right! Even if the whole world turns
against you, Lili is on your side, Mr. Bell.
So... come here. Quickly.
theater_event_24_10_06_005:
...? You two...
aren't you acting kind of weird?
theater_event_24_10_06_006:
Oh, come on. Whatever do you mean? It's me,
the same Hestia you love. Now, hurry over here?
theater_event_24_10_06_007:
That's right. Lili and the goddess will protect
you, Mr. Bell. Come on! Over here, quickly.
Closer!
theater_event_24_10_06_009:
"The woman-cursed rabbit falls into the prison
of deep betrayal at year's start, never to
rise again"...!!
theater_event_24_10_06_010:
Prison of betrayal... Don't tell me, you two...
You're in the Lucky Maiden Race too...?
theater_event_24_10_06_013:
Bell... Let's tour the islands of Dizara together
and climb even higher up the stairway of love!!
theater_event_24_10_06_014:
No! Mr. Bell will spend a dreamy time with Lili in
the pleasure city of Santorio Vega! And yes!
This is the year I stop being a little sister!!
theater_event_24_10_06_015:
I'M the one going on a lovey-dovey trip with Bell!!
LILI is the one going on a lovey-dovey trip
with Mr. Bell!!
theater_event_24_10_06_017:
Bell, wait!!
Mr. Bell, please wait!!
theater_event_24_10_06_018: Th-that's awful... Even Goddess and Lili...
theater_event_24_10_06_019:
I have no allies left in this city...
I just have to run...
theater_event_24_10_06_020:
THERE you are!! Finally, I've got you!!
Death to my sworn enemy! Bell Cranel,
hand over your head!!
theater_event_24_10_06_021:
M-Miss Lefiyaaa?!
Isn't that way too murderous?! This is a game
about catching me, you know?!
theater_event_24_10_06_022:
After sweating in the steam bath, drinking health
tea made with local herbs, back into the hot spring,
an acupressure massage, then sleeping soundly...
theater_event_24_10_06_023:
Hot springs, sleep, acupressure... a meal, then hot
springs, acupressure, and sleep again... Ahh...
I must hurry... to my journey of healing release...
theater_event_24_10_06_024:
Miss Asfi?! Why do you look like someone
trapped by a curse of relaxation?!
theater_event_24_10_06_025: This is DEFINITELY not good fortune!!
theater_event_24_10_06_027:
Chased by so many women at the start of the year,
I'm jealous! Ganesha wants to be chased too!
theater_event_24_10_06_028:
Once again the Little Rookie's swift feet get
him out of a jam! But is that wise?!
Because up ahead is—
theater_event_24_10_06_032: (I knew it! I can't get away!!)
theater_event_24_10_06_035:
Ms. Wallensteeein! Your favorite, Jyaga Maru-kun!
And it's red bean cream flavor! Heeere you go!
theater_event_24_10_06_039:
Ms. Wallenstein really loves these, huh~.
Here! One more, toss!!
theater_event_24_10_06_041:
Bell, now's your chance! There's an underground
passage only Guild staff know about...!
theater_event_24_10_07_001: There's a safe place up ahead. Follow me.
theater_event_24_10_07_004:
I was just wondering if it's okay for someone
from the Guild to take my side...
theater_event_24_10_07_005:
Once the venue prep was done, they said we could
enjoy the Maiden Race like everyone else.
theater_event_24_10_07_006:
So right now, I'm not a Guild employee.
I'm just Eina Tulle, private citizen.
theater_event_24_10_07_007: So there's no problem at all. Come on, let's go—
theater_event_24_10_07_009:
—Here, some tea.
You must be thirsty after all that running.
theater_event_24_10_07_011:
Um. Bell... I'm sorry.
I couldn't stop the Guild Head from forcing
that Lucky Man quest on you...
theater_event_24_10_07_012:
Th-that's not... You have your position to think
about, Miss Eina... And just helping me like
this is... ugh...
theater_event_24_10_07_015:
All the women chased me like I'd killed their
parents... Even Goddess and Lili... and Ms. Ais...
theater_event_24_10_07_016: I think... I'm going to stop trusting women...
theater_event_24_10_07_017:
But you helped me, Miss Eina, and I feel saved...
This warm tea is soaking all the way into
my heart...
theater_event_24_10_07_020:
—Aaah! Found you!!
Little Bro and Eina, you're both safe~.
theater_event_24_10_07_021:
Yes! Thanks to you...
Really... thank you so much!
theater_event_24_10_07_023: Squeeze and secured! First Fortune is mine!
theater_event_24_10_07_025:
Yay, yay! A four-day, three-night trip to the
Alv Mountains! Can't wait, Eina!
theater_event_24_10_07_026:
Huh? What? This is... a joke, right...?
Miss Eina...?
theater_event_24_10_07_027:
Um... well... I thought it wasn't right after all.
I tried to stop it, but... Misha came...
theater_event_24_10_07_029:
Now, now. I'm the one who pushed her into
helping me. Don't blame her too much.
theater_event_24_10_07_030:
Oh, but Eina was all, "The elves' sacred
mountains... I might want to go"—
theater_event_24_10_07_031:
And "Sweets made with Alv spring water? Those
sound delicious!" She was pretty into it, right~?
theater_event_24_10_07_033:
Ah... ugh... So this is what Miss Cassandra said...
Falling into the prison of betrayal,
never to rise again...
theater_event_24_10_07_035:
BEEEEELL CRANEEEEEL! Hugging a woman in a place
like this inn... you filthy, lecherous rabbiiiit!!
theater_event_24_10_07_036:
Oh, I was so happy I kept squeezing him.
Sorry, Little Bro~.
theater_event_24_10_07_037:
Bell came this way— Hey, what are you DOING?!
Don't tell me that Guild girl's joining the
fight over Bell too?!
theater_event_24_10_07_038:
I was so focused on Miss Eina, who's nearly
certain to be trouble, but the Guild had
another ambush waiting?!
theater_event_24_10_07_039:
My hot springs... are gone? Why, Bell Cranel?!
Do I not even have the right to seek
a moment's respite?!
theater_event_24_10_07_040:
Heh, still, an inn is pretty convenient, isn't it?
Maybe we should just get started right here?
theater_event_24_10_07_041:
G-g-g-get started?!
B-B-B-Bell... surely not in front of
everyone...
theater_event_24_10_07_043:
The Sword Princess said she heard your voice.
As for the Sword Princess herself, along the way—
theater_event_24_10_07_045:
Well, looks like that girl took the First Fortune,
but there's still Second and Third Fortune left.
theater_event_24_10_07_046:
Yes! Attacking the Lucky Man is every
maiden candidate's right!
theater_event_24_10_07_047:
I shall exercise that right to vent my rage over my
ruined trip with Ms. Ais— I mean, to deliver
well-deserved punishment!!
theater_event_24_10_07_048: What happened to Second and Third Fortune?!
theater_event_24_10_07_049:
Silence!! Now, there's no escape in this cramped
room! Prepare yourself, Bell Craneeeeel!!
